coordinate_language: Express normalized boxes as approximate left/top/width/height percentages, while retaining normalized values in task metadata.
lettering_rule: When text.mode is deterministic_lettering, reserve declared regions but generate no speech balloons, captions, or readable text.
reference_rule: Name every reference by index and role; the first approved character identity reference is authoritative for that character.
continuity_rule: Repeat identity and state invariants explicitly; do not rely on the model inferring them from earlier tasks.
